_note: Our own lists. A pilot's origin is a richer background: where they grew up, how, who they worked for, what they're good at. By the book a background can be invoked for +1 Accuracy on a relevant skill check (Core p.20); an origin only widens what counts as relevant (its tags), it never adds a second bonus, License Levels or gear. Perks with kind 'combat' are for the rules engine's 'Origin perks' house rule (off by default; the user's idea, not a book rule). Food likes follow from the origin (the food-and-water house rule).

homeworld.name: City kid
homeworld.text: Grew up in a metroswathe: crowds, noise, every street a shortcut.

homeworld.name: Desert world
homeworld.text: Water was worth more than money where you grew up.

homeworld.name: Ice world
homeworld.text: Long nights, deep cold, people who never waste anything.

homeworld.name: Ocean world
homeworld.text: Platforms, boats and storms; you can swim before you can walk.

homeworld.name: Jungle world
homeworld.text: Green, loud and alive; everything bites.

homeworld.name: Spacer (Cosmopolitan)
homeworld.text: Born in transit at near light speed; worlds come and go, the ship stays (Core p.20).

homeworld.name: Orbital habitat
homeworld.text: Spun-up gravity, recycled air, neighbours on every side.

homeworld.name: Frontier colony
homeworld.text: A young settlement where everyone does a bit of everything.

homeworld.name: Union Core
homeworld.text: Cradle or a world near it: communal, post-capital, very far from the frontier (Core p.10).

homeworld.name: Mining world
homeworld.text: Dust in the lungs and a company store at the end of every shift.

homeworld.name: Agri world
homeworld.text: Endless fields, early mornings, weather is everything.

effect.note: +1 Accuracy on attacks against the former employer's frames, once per scene (Origin perks house rule)
